ask: can u make a deck of question cards for sat? like 40, we draw in turn from the same shuffle and no skips
sentence: A shared deck of 40 conversation question cards that is shuffled once, then members take turns drawing the next card in the same order, with no skips.
use_when: a group wants icebreaker or get-to-know-you questions to pass around
everyone should draw from one shared shuffled deck in turn
a casual hangout needs a simple turn-based question game
no skipping or redrawing is wanted
dont_use_when: players need to write their own questions or custom cards
a competitive game with scores or winners is needed
a quick vote or poll on one question is needed

options: Favorite thing in the dining hall?
